advanced.title: Advanced details
advanced.dek: For the curious. Nothing here needs changing.
advanced.error: Nocturne couldn’t read these details. What you kept is safe.
advanced.models.unavailable: Choosing models isn’t available here. What you kept is safe.
advanced.npu.cause.driverMissing: the amdxdna kernel driver is not loaded
advanced.npu.cause.driverOld: the amdxdna driver is too old
advanced.npu.cause.kernelOld: the kernel is too old for the NPU
advanced.npu.cause.firmwareOld: the NPU firmware is too old
advanced.npu.cause.memoryLock: the memory lock limit (ulimit -l) is too low
advanced.npu.cause.notSupported: the engine does not support this NPU
advanced.npu.cause.tooLittleMemory: its speech model does not fit the memory budget beside the others
advanced.npu.cause.notFetched: its runtime or speech model is not downloaded; Run setup again fetches them
advanced.npu.cause.chosen: a speech model was chosen for reading recordings
advanced.npu.cause.failed: it failed; recordings are read on the GPU or CPU
advanced.npu.fix.driverMissing: Use Linux 7.0 or later, or install amdxdna-dkms, and check amd_iommu=off is not on the kernel command line; then restart.
advanced.npu.fix.driverOld: Update the amdxdna driver (a newer kernel or amdxdna-dkms), then restart.
advanced.npu.fix.kernelOld: Update to Linux 7.0 or later, then restart.
advanced.npu.fix.firmwareOld: Update linux-firmware so the NPU firmware is 1.1.0.0 or later, then restart.
advanced.npu.fix.memoryLock: Set memlock to unlimited in /etc/security/limits.conf (soft and hard), then log out and back in.

advanced.reset.title: Reset Nocturne?
advanced.reset.body: This removes everything and takes Nocturne back to its first setup. Export first if you might want your memories.

advanced.online.connect.title: Connect to the service you chose.
advanced.online.connect.lead: Copy three things from its website. They’re usually on a page about keys, or in its quick start guide.
advanced.online.connect.address.hint: Starts with https://, or http:// for a server on this computer or your own network. Copy all of it.
advanced.online.connect.key.hint: A long code the service gives you. It stays on this computer, locked away.
advanced.online.connect.name: Which one to use
advanced.online.connect.name.placeholder: The exact name from its website
advanced.online.connect.needsCheck: Continue works once the check passes.
advanced.online.connect.checkingDetail: Nocturne’s engine is sending one short test question. Nothing you kept goes with it.
advanced.online.connect.works.detail: Nocturne will call it “your provider ({host})” on every answer it writes.
advanced.online.connect.unreachable.deta: Check it’s copied exactly, including the part after the last slash.
advanced.online.connect.keyRefused.detai: Check you copied all of it. Some services also need credit on the account before a key works.
advanced.online.connect.noCredit.detail: Add credit on its website, then check again.
advanced.online.connect.modelMissing.det: Copy the name exactly as its website shows it. Capitals and dashes matter.
advanced.online.connect.noInternet: This computer isn’t connected to the internet.
advanced.online.connect.noInternet.detai: Connect, then check again. Nothing was sent.
advanced.online.connect.notHttps: That address doesn’t start with https://.
advanced.online.connect.notHttps.detail: Online, Nocturne only connects to addresses that start with https://, so what it sends stays locked on the way. http:// works for this computer and your own network.
advanced.online.connect.addressNotAllowe: That kind of address never answers questions. Use the address your provider gives, with nothing after it. Nothing was sent.
advanced.online.connect.busy.detail: It asked for a pause. Wait a moment, then check again.
advanced.online.connect.serverError: {host} had a problem on its side.
advanced.online.connect.serverError.deta: Try again in a few minutes.
advanced.online.connect.emptyReply.detai: Check that the name to use is exactly as its website shows it, then check again.
advanced.online.connect.aside.heading: Which service?
advanced.online.connect.aside.any: Any service that answers the way OpenAI’s does. For example OpenAI, OpenRouter, Mistral, Groq or DeepInfra.
advanced.online.connect.aside.neutral: Nocturne doesn’t recommend one. Each has its own prices, and its own page about what it keeps. Read that before you choose.
advanced.online.connect.aside.lock: Nocturne gives the key only to its own engine on this computer, which uses it to reach that address and nowhere else.
